monetization.noteEs: Sistema gacha con personajes (Espers) y Arcs (armas) obtenibles por banners usando currency premium. El juego es un open-world urbano sobrenatural single-player con cooperativo limitado, completable como F2P aunque obtener personajes SS-Class específicos puede requerir gasto. Las microtransacciones incluyen battle pass, monthly card, bundles de currency y cosméticos.
monetization.noteEn: Gacha system with characters (Espers) and Arcs (weapons) obtainable via banners using premium currency. The game is a supernatural urban open-world with single-player focus and limited co-op, fully completable as F2P though specific SS-Class characters can require spending. Microtransactions include battle pass, monthly card, currency bundles, and cosmetics.
